title: Swat & Kalam Summer
summary: Four days from Lahore up the Swat valley to Kalam: Ushu forest, Mahodand Lake and the river at Bahrain, out of the summer heat.

image.alt: A white-water stream over dark boulders through the conifers of Ushu forest near Kalam

overview.headline: Four days up the Swat valley to Kalam, out of the summer heat
paragraphs: We drive straight up the Swat valley to Kalam on the first day and stay two nights by the river, in the pine forests at the top of the valley.
The full day in Kalam takes in the Ushu forest and Mahodand Lake by jeep. On the way back we stop at the White Palace at Marghazar before a night in Mingora.
suitedTo: Friends and couples who want a cool summer break
Travellers short on leave who still want real mountains
notSuitedTo: Anyone who dislikes a long first day: it is 9 to 10 hours on the road
Travellers outside summer, when the road above Kalam can close

faqs.question: How long is the first day?
faqs.answer: About 9 to 10 hours with stops, as we drive straight to Kalam. It means two full nights at the top of the valley rather than one.

faqs.question: Is it safe to travel to Swat?
faqs.answer: Swat has been a busy family holiday valley for years. We travel the main roads, stay in established hotels and follow local advice; if anything changes before your date, we tell you on WhatsApp.
